display.purpose: God names, dialog headings — condensed geometric caps for a console-display feel.

label.purpose: Section eyebrows, counts, status tags — small, uppercase, tracked.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Floating surfaces resting just above the page (tooltips, popovers).

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Modals and dialogs sitting fully above the page.

shadows.name: glow
shadows.purpose: Selected-state halo on a god card; the one place shadow doubles as the accent color.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Tactile press feedback on tappable cards/pills/tabs; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single confirming action per view (e.g. a dialog's "Got it").
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #e3b23c; color: #0b0e13; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: none; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4ea3ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip (active)
components.description: Selected pill filter (e.g. active lane filter).
components.css: .ds-chip-active { background: #e3b23c; color: #0b0e13; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-chip-active:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Filter Chip (inactive)
components.css: .ds-chip-inactive { background: transparent; color: #8b95a5; font-size: 11px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #1e2530; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1); } .ds-chip-inactive:hover { color: #c3cad6; } .ds-chip-inactive:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: God Card (selected)
components.description: The elevated, gold-bordered selection state for a god card.
components.css: .ds-card-selected { background: #171c24; border: 1px solid #e3b23c; border-radius: 14px; padding: 6px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(227,178,60,0.4), 0 4px 14px rgba(227,178,60,0.15); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-card-name { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 10.5px; color: #e8edf4; }

components.name: God Card (rest)
components.css: .ds-card-rest { background: #12161d; border: 1px solid #1e2530; border-radius: 14px; padding: 6px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1), transform 120ms; } .ds-card-rest:hover { border-color: #2a3342; } .ds-card-rest:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-card-name { font-family: 'Rajdhani', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 10.5px; color: #e8edf4; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: The god/item search field — focus is communicated by border color alone.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: transparent; color: #e8edf4; font-size: 12px; border: none; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8b95a5; } .ds-input-wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #1e2530; background: #12161d; padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-input-wrap:focus-within { border-color: #4ea3ff; }

components.name: Tooltip
components.css: .ds-tooltip { border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #1e2530; background: #12161d; color: #c3cad6; font-size: 12px; padding: 12px; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); max-width: 260px; }

components.name: Label / Eyebrow
components.description: The mono, uppercase, tracked label used for section headers and status tags (e.g. "Pinned").
components.css: .ds-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-weight: 500; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #e3b23c; }

narrative.overview:
ichor reads like a battlefield after dark: a near-black field (rail / bg0) with one warm accent — torchlight gold — marking whatever matters right now, and role-tinted banners (guardian, warrior, mid, hunter, assassin) identifying the different lanes at a glance. Nothing about the surface competes with the data; the theme exists to make the model's output legible, not to decorate the app.

The philosophy is tactical and data-dense: small, precise labels; a lot of information per element (stats, signals, icons) held together by strict alignment; and a confident, instrumented feel closer to a mission console than a game skin. It deliberately avoids the cutesy rounded gradients and RGB-lightshow look common to "gamer" UI — that is the confirmed visual anti-reference. Gold is rare and load-bearing, not a brand color splashed everywhere.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black surfaces stepped in four tiers (rail → bg0 → bg2 → bg3), each one step "closer" or more elevated.
One accent (torchlight gold) reserved for selection, primary action, and the model's own signal.
Role/lane colors are semantic, not decorative — they always mean "this is a Solo/Jungle/Mid/Carry/Support thing."
Dense, mono-labeled data sits next to display headings and Inter body text without ever feeling cluttered.
Flat at rest; lift (shadow, glow) appears only when something is selected, active, or floating above the page.

rules.name: The Torchlight Rule
rules.body: Gold is load-bearing, not decorative: it appears only on the current selection, the primary action, or the model's own signal. If a design use of gold isn't one of those three, it's wrong.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Role and damage colors always carry meaning (a specific lane or damage type); never repurpose them as arbitrary decoration elsewhere in the UI.

rules.name: The Mono-Label Rule
rules.body: Any piece of UI that names a category, state, or count rather than describing content sets in JetBrains Mono, uppercase, tracked — never Inter.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-It-Matters Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadow only appears for a floating layer (tooltip, modal) or a selected state (glow) — never as ambient decoration on a resting card.

dos: Do reserve torchlight gold for selection, primary action, or the model's own signal (score/efficiency) — see the Torchlight Rule.
Do set any label, tag, or count in JetBrains Mono, uppercase and tracked, per the Mono-Label Rule.
Do keep loading states as layout-shaped skeletons (pulsing bg-bg2 bars), never a spinner or centered "Loading…".
Do use the shared .press scale-down for every tappable element, and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add shadow to a resting surface for decoration — shadow means "floating" (tooltip/modal) or "selected" (glow), per the Flat-Until-It-Matters Rule.
Don't repurpose a role/lane or damage-type color for anything other than that specific lane or damage type.
Don't introduce rounded gradients, neon glows, or angular esports-style slashes — the confirmed anti-reference for this system.
Don't add a second accent hue alongside torchlight gold; secondary interactive state is focus-blue's job, not a new color.
